name: Topcoat
workers: Tokio multi-threaded runtime, one worker per available CPU (2)
logging: none (Topcoat logs nothing per request by default)

phase2.validation: path_param!(id: i32 else not_found) (404), #[query_params(error = bad_request)], content::Json and content::Form (400); ranges checked by hand (400)

csrf.mechanism: built-in OriginPolicy (Sec-Fetch-Site, then Origin against Host; 403), on by default for every unsafe request

session.mechanism: built-in session feature (token in a __Host- cookie via CookieLayer); token hash, user id and expiry in user_sessions, read with Toasty

maturity_note: early 0.x framework, measured with its documented defaults
notes: Topcoat describes itself as early-stage and experimental, with breaking changes expected.
